Metadata.title: Development Plan for Obsidian Memory MCP Server
Metadata.approval: Architecture approved by user; this plan is the execution baseline.

ArchitecturePrinciples.principle: Vault Markdown files are the source of truth.
Index, embeddings, audit projections and wiki pages are derivative layers.
All writes are planned through policy, change planning, lock/revision and audit boundaries.
Mutation services return affected_paths; index refresh is coordinated by entrypoint or background worker.
No delete, bulk move, unrestricted rename or direct autonomous Wiki writes in MVP.

Module.name: MCPServerEntrypoint
Module.purpose: Exposes Streamable HTTP MCP tools and coordinates auth, policy, mutation, retrieval, index refresh and health endpoints.
Module.scope: Tool registration, request routing, auth/policy orchestration, service invocation, affected_paths handoff, health/admin endpoints.
Module.observability: Must create trace_id and emit tool routing, policy outcome and service result anchors.
Module.rationale: Central orchestration keeps MCP transport thin while preventing service-to-service cycles such as mutation directly refreshing index.

Module.name: AuthIdentityService
Module.purpose: Resolves agent identity, API key, role and policy profile.
Module.scope: API key validation, identity mapping, profile resolution, invalid credential rejection.
Module.observability: Emit auth.identity.resolved or auth.identity.rejected without logging secrets.
Module.rationale: Identity resolution is separated from policy decisions so credentials and authorization rules remain independently testable.

Module.name: VaultPolicyGuard
Module.purpose: Enforces allowlist, denylist, no-delete, no-bulk-move, dry-run, propose-only and symlink-deny policies.
Module.scope: Path policy, operation capability matrix, profile-specific permissions, write restrictions, propose-only enforcement.
Module.observability: Emit policy.decision for every read, search, mutation, promotion and wiki operation.
Module.rationale: Centralized policy prevents inconsistent enforcement across tools and reduces the damage radius of autonomous agents.

Module.name: VaultReadService
Module.purpose: Provides safe read/list/exists/metadata operations over allowed Vault paths.
Module.scope: Read note content, list allowed paths, check file existence, compute metadata and revision for allowed files.
Module.observability: Emit read.started and read.completed with path and revision metadata only after policy approval.
Module.rationale: Read operations still need policy enforcement because private Vault paths must not leak through convenience tools.

Module.name: VaultFilesystemRepository
Module.purpose: Performs normalized path resolution, symlink denial, file reads, metadata inspection and atomic writes.
Module.scope: Vault root confinement, path traversal prevention, symlink checks, file IO, atomic write primitive and move primitive.
Module.observability: Emit path.resolved, path.denied, vault.atomic_write.completed and vault.atomic_move.completed.
Module.rationale: Filesystem safety is isolated so every service uses the same normalized path and symlink denial semantics.

Module.name: ChangePlanner
Module.purpose: Builds dry-run diffs, validates constrained patches and creates executable mutation plans.
Module.scope: Patch validation, dry-run diff generation, post-apply Markdown validation, mutation plan creation.
Module.rationale: Planning changes before execution makes autonomous writes reviewable and protects against free-form destructive edits.

Module.name: LockAndRevisionService
Module.purpose: Provides hybrid locks and sha256(content) optimistic concurrency checks.
Module.scope: Per-path asyncio locks, filesystem-level locks, expected/current revision comparison, external sync recheck.
Module.rationale: External sync can change files outside local process locks, so write safety requires both locking and content-hash revalidation.

Module.name: VaultMutationService
Module.purpose: Executes approved create/append/edit/write operations and returns affected_paths without calling index refresh directly.
Module.scope: Apply MutationPlan, invoke atomic writes, coordinate audit, return mutation results.
Module.rationale: Mutation is deliberately decoupled from index refresh to preserve the dependency DAG and make write failures easier to reason about.

Module.name: AuditLogService
Module.purpose: Writes authoritative machine-readable audit events and updates LOG.md projection.
Module.scope: Append audit event, write human projection, associate trace_id, avoid recursive audit loops.
Module.rationale: Machine-readable audit supports verification and forensic reconstruction while LOG.md preserves human-readable Obsidian visibility.

Module.name: RetrievalService
Module.purpose: Provides keyword, FTS, optional semantic, similar-notes, wiki-source retrieval and explainable ranking.
Module.scope: Search query orchestration, FTS retrieval, optional vector retrieval, policy filtering, ranking explanation.
Module.rationale: Retrieval must filter at response time because derivative indexes may temporarily contain stale entries.

Module.name: ConfigService
Module.purpose: Loads server, Vault, auth, policy, index, audit and backup configuration.
Module.scope: Parse configuration, provide typed settings, validate required settings, expose policy and backend choices.
Module.observability: May expose sanitized config summary; must not log secrets.
Module.rationale: Configuration centralization prevents policy and backend drift between modules.

Module.name: ObservabilityService
Module.purpose: Provides structured logs, request IDs, trace anchors and error taxonomy.
Module.scope: Trace context, structured log helper, error codes, audit correlation IDs.
Module.observability: This module defines the observability surface for all other modules.
Module.rationale: Autonomous execution needs stable trace anchors to diagnose policy, mutation and index failures.

Module.name: IndexRepository
Module.purpose: Maintains SQLite metadata, FTS5, audit-index access and future vector tables derived from Vault files.
Module.scope: SQLite schema, FTS operations, index state, WAL/busy_timeout initialization, derivative metadata persistence.
Module.rationale: Keeping index persistence separate reinforces that the index is rebuildable and not the source of truth.

Module.name: IndexRefreshService
Module.purpose: Rebuilds or incrementally updates the index from Vault content and affected_paths.
Module.scope: refresh_paths, startup_reconcile, refresh_wiki_folder, single writer queue coordination, optional vector update.
Module.rationale: Refresh is a supervised derivative update triggered outside mutation execution to prevent cycles and preserve write safety.

Module.name: MarkdownSemanticParser
Module.purpose: Extracts frontmatter, tags, links, headings, sections and validates post-apply Markdown shape.
Module.scope: Markdown parsing, section extraction, heading paths, link extraction, post-apply validation.
Module.observability: Emit markdown.parse.completed and markdown.validation.failed when applicable.
Module.rationale: A reusable semantic parser keeps edit validation, indexing and wiki source extraction consistent.

Module.name: VectorSearchAdapter
Module.purpose: Provides optional vector search via disabled/sqlite-vec/qdrant-optional implementations.
Module.scope: Backend selection, vector upsert/query abstraction, graceful degradation to FTS.
Module.rationale: The boundary describes semantic retrieval capability instead of binding architecture to Qdrant prematurely.

Module.name: BackupService
Module.purpose: Exposes manual Git backup/health integration without implementing rollback API in MVP.
Module.scope: Backup health check, manual backup trigger, status reporting, no content mutation beyond Git operations.
Module.rationale: Manual Git backup provides recoverability without adding risky rollback API surface to MVP.

Module.name: WikiUpdateService
Module.purpose: Finds wiki sources and generates propose-only diffs for 70_Wiki.
Module.scope: Wiki source retrieval, proposed update generation, diff output, no autonomous write.
Module.rationale: Wiki pages are synthesized knowledge and should be reviewed as proposed diffs before mutation.

Module.name: DraftPromotionService
Module.purpose: Controls single-note promote/move workflows from inbox or future drafts to approved destinations.
Module.scope: Validate source/destination roots, dry-run, no-overwrite, single-file move, audit event, affected_paths result.
Module.rationale: Promotion is a high-risk lifecycle transition and needs a narrower contract than unrestricted move/rename.

forbidden_edge.rationale: Would create mutation/index coupling and risk circular dependency.

DataFlow.name: SafeRead
DataFlow.sequence: Agent MCP Client -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-004 -> M-005 -> return content + revision + metadata
DataFlow.rationale: Read path passes policy so denylisted content is never exposed.

DataFlow.name: SafeMutation
DataFlow.sequence: Agent MCP Client -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-006 -> M-007 -> M-008 -> M-009 -> return mutation result + affected_paths -> M-001/background worker -> M-014
DataFlow.rationale: Mutation planning, revision recheck, atomic write and audit are required before derivative index refresh.

DataFlow.name: RetrievalSearch
DataFlow.sequence: Agent MCP Client -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-010 -> M-013/M-016 -> M-003 result filter -> return snippets/sources/ranking explanation
DataFlow.rationale: Retrieval re-checks policy to avoid stale index leaks.

DataFlow.name: IndexRefreshFromMutationResult
DataFlow.sequence: Mutation result -> affected_paths -> M-001/background worker -> M-014 -> M-003 -> M-005 -> M-015 -> M-013 -> optional M-016

DataFlow.name: WikiProposeOnlyUpdate
DataFlow.sequence: Agent -> M-001 -> M-010.find_wiki_sources -> M-018 -> M-006 preview -> return proposal diff
DataFlow.rationale: Wiki automation proposes changes rather than mutating synthesized knowledge directly.

DataFlow.name: DraftInboxPromotion
DataFlow.sequence: Trusted Agent -> M-001 -> M-002 -> M-003 -> M-019 -> M-007 -> M-005 -> M-009 -> return affected_paths
DataFlow.rationale: Promotion is constrained to single-note trusted move with dry-run, no-overwrite and audit.

Phase.name: FoundationAndPolicy
Phase.rationale: Safety, configuration, identity and path boundaries must exist before any MCP tool can safely expose Vault access.

Phase.name: ReadOnlyMCP
Phase.step: Expose read-only MCP tools over Streamable HTTP.
Phase.rationale: Read-only execution validates transport, identity, policy and path resolution before mutations are introduced.

Phase.name: SafeMutationPipeline
Phase.rationale: Writes are only safe after dry-run, constrained patch validation, hybrid locks, external sync revision recheck and audit exist.

Phase.name: SQLiteFTSRetrieval
Phase.step: Implement IndexRepository with SQLite FTS5 and WAL.
Phase.rationale: Reliable MVP search should be local, rebuildable and policy-filtered before semantic retrieval is added.

Phase.name: PromotionBackupAndOps
Phase.step: Implement BackupService manual Git backup integration.
Phase.rationale: Promotion and backup are operational risk surfaces and must be verified before wiki and semantic expansion.

Phase.name: WikiProposeOnlyAutomation
Phase.step: Support refresh_wiki_folder as index refresh, not autonomous wiki write.
Phase.rationale: Wiki automation is content-risky and must remain propose-only.

Phase.name: OptionalSemanticRetrieval
Phase.step: Extend RetrievalService for hybrid search and similar notes.
Phase.rationale: Semantic retrieval is useful after MVP but must degrade cleanly to FTS and not become a core reliability dependency.

Risk.description: Agent overwrites external Obsidian Sync change.
Risk.mitigation: sha256(content) expected_revision plus recheck before write.
affected_paths result; M-001 or background worker calls M-014.
Policy at indexing and response time.
Deny path if any component is symlink.
Trusted profile, dry-run, diff, revision recheck and audit.

Risk.description: SQLite locked under concurrent index writes.
Risk.mitigation: WAL, busy_timeout and single writer queue.
Authoritative SQLite/NDJSON audit and LOG.md projection.
